features: EXPAND YOUR STORAGE- Insert your card to add massive storage up to 1.5TB* to your Android smartphones and tablets, digital cameras, and laptops.

description: Ideal for AndroidTM smartphones and tablets, digital cameras, and laptops, the SANDISK Ultra® GO microSDTM UHS-I Card gives you the freedom to store more than ever. With capacities up to 1.5TB, it has room for hours of TV shows, movies, Full HD video, music, documents, games, photos, and podcasts. And with the help of the SANDISK® Memory Zone app, you can automatically back up your favorite content to help keep it safe. Transfer speeds of up to 190MB/s[128GB-1.5TB models] help you move your content blazingly fast, and an A1 app performance rating means that you can load apps faster, too.
